brief: An 8-second line chart: an x-axis labelled Jan to Jun and a y-axis from 0 to 100 with gridlines every 25; a line draws left to right through the values 20, 35, 30, 60, 75, 90; each point gets a dot and its value label at the moment the line reaches it; at the end a dashed horizontal target line at 80 appears with the label 'Target'.
checks: Is the x‑axis present and labelled Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun in that order from left to right?
Is the y‑axis present with tick marks (or gridlines) at 0, 25, 50, 75, 100 and does it extend vertically across the chart area?
Are thin gridlines visible at each 25‑unit interval (0, 25, 50, 75, 100) spanning the chart width?
Does the line draw from left to right with a smooth ease‑in/ease‑out motion (no constant‑speed segments)?
As the line reaches each data point, does a dot appear exactly at that point and remain visible thereafter?
When each dot appears, does its corresponding value label (20, 35, 30, 60, 75, 90) appear near the dot and stay on screen?
Do the dots/labels appear in the correct sequence: Jan→20, Feb→35, Mar→30, Apr→60, May→75, Jun→90?
Do all visual elements (axes, labels, dots, line, gridlines, target line) stay inside the frame with a clear margin, never touching or crossing the edge?
After the Jun point, does a dashed horizontal line appear at the 80‑unit level spanning the chart width, accompanied by the label “Target”?
Does the dashed target line and its label remain on screen for at least the final 0.5 second before the video ends?
In every one‑second interval of the 8‑second video, does at least one element move, change opacity, or appear (i.e., no dead air)?
Does the colour scheme appear harmonious (neutral axes/grid, saturated line, contrasting dots, distinct target line) with no clashing hues?
Are there any visible glitches, flicker, overlapping text, or rendering artifacts in the video?
Does the picture fill the entire frame with no black bars, borders, masks, or hard‑edged vignettes?
